effects: Download CloudRoom gui-v9001 (Cloudroom-v9001-x86_64.AppImage) from CloudRoom's GitHub release.
Check it against the SHA-256 CloudRoom publishes (22a496c5d641...); install nothing if it differs.
Install it at ~/Applications/Cloudroom.AppImage. Nothing existing is replaced.
Change nothing else. Sign-in happens in CloudRoom's own window.
